request_user:
Fact: training_method
What to find: Main stages and methods of training (pretraining, SFT, preference optimisation/DPO, RL, distillation, merging).
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Training Procedure, Post-training

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Training pipeline: Multimodal Continual Pre-Training (CPT), Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and Cascade Reinforcement Learning (CascadeRL). CascadeRL first uses Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) under offline RL (combining DPO loss, BCO loss and LM loss), followed by GSPO under online RL. Pre-training updates all model parameters jointly on large-scale text and multimodal corpora with next-token-prediction loss. The Flash version additionally uses Visual Consistency Learning (ViCO).
quotes: Our training pipeline comprises four stages: Multimodal Continual Pre-Training (**CPT**), Supervised Fine-Tuning (**SFT**), and Cascade Reinforcement Learning (**CascadeRL**). In CascadeRL, we first fine-tune the model using Mixed Preference Optimization (**MPO**) under an offline RL setting, followed by **GSPO** under an oneline RL setting.

For the Flash version of InternVL3.5, we additionally introduce a lightweight training stage, termed Visual Consistency Learning (**ViCO**), which reduces the token cost required to represent an image patch.
During the pre-training stage, we update all model parameters jointly using the combination of large-scale text and multimodal corpora.
The DPO loss, BCO loss, and LM loss serve as the preference loss, quality loss, and generation loss, respectively.
